title: Unfinished lakeside
summary: A lakeside plot where the previous builder stopped halfway: one fenced habitat waits for a path, staff and animals, and the food stand has no visitors yet.

objectives.title: Finish the path to the habitat's service gate
Staff the habitat and adopt animals
Have 8 guests in the park at once

land.title: East Paddock
land.summary: Open dry pasture at the end of the main path: room for a large habitat with a short path, at nearly twice the lakeshore's price.

land.title: Lakeshore
land.summary: The cheapest plot and the lake guests come to see, but the water leaves only strips of grass and no path reaches it yet.

land.title: South Meadow
land.summary: The largest plot, beside the entrance and the food stand, but the town sells it only once the zoo has animals on show.

unlock.description: opens once a habitat has animals
